deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 (the Statistics deadline in the Faculty of Graduate Studies list); the department page gives January 15 as its funding-consideration deadline, so apply by mid-December to be safe.
deadline.quote: Many departments have their own deadlines, which can be much earlier than the above deadlines. | Statistics December 15

also.quote: The deadline for graduate applications, for those wishing to be considered for funding, is January 15 of each year.

entry_route.quote: Thesis-based master's degree or its equivalent.

notes: PhD typically 4 years; comprehensive exam within the first year. The FGS lists a 3.5 minimum admission GPA for Statistics.
